name: Greco-Persian Wars
description: The Achaemenid Empire's attempts to subdue the Greek city-states, turned back at Marathon, Salamis, and Plataea. Victory preserved Greek political independence and launched Athens' imperial golden age.

name: Peloponnesian War
description: The ruinous struggle between Athens' naval empire and Sparta's land alliance, chronicled by Thucydides as a study in power politics. Plague, the Sicilian disaster, and Persian gold brought Athens down — and exhausted Greece for Macedon's taking.

name: Punic Wars
description: Three wars between Rome and Carthage for the western Mediterranean — including Hannibal's Alpine invasion and Cannae, Rome's darkest defeat — ending with Carthage razed and Rome the unrivalled Mediterranean power.
